dogecoin.text:
Saturday Night Live would’ve been more entertaining if Elon Musk and Miley Cyrus lived up to their hype and got dogecoin to the moon. But it teaches us an important lesson. A lot of little guys have to lose in order to make a few big guys very wealthy.

Because that’s real life.

It took rooting for dogecoin to go to the moon for me to actually take the effort to watch a Saturday Night Live episode for the first time. No offense to Elon Musk, but I found the show to be a bit boring. Since I never watch, I don’t know it it was Elon or just SNL in general.
I’m rooting for Dogecoin to go straight up to the moon! #dogetothemoon
